summary: Adapter modules that implement composite driver-kwarg mappings for backends with non-trivial auth-to-driver translation: BigQuery, Databricks, MSSQL, MySQL, PyIceberg REST, PySpark, Redshift, Snowflake, Trino. Each adapter is a callable(profile) -> dict[str, Any] assigned as __adapter__ on the corresponding settings class.
extension_points: Callable signature: adapter(profile: ConnectionProfile) -> dict[str, Any]
lifecycle_notes: Adapters are called by ConnectionProfile.to_driver_kwargs() when __adapter__ is set.
Adapters that are None (or absent) fall through to the default descriptor driver_key mapping.
